title: A calmer chat · 0.4.0
description: Chat now works like the AI apps you know: your question moves to the top, replies are properly formatted, and the chat bar is one Liquid Glass control.
notes: Sending puts your question at the top of the screen and the reply writes below it, without the screen chasing the text; a Latest button appears when you scroll away.
Replies show headings, lists, quotes, tables and code blocks with a Copy button, all selectable.
The chat bar is a single Liquid Glass control with +, your message and Send or Stop; tap the conversation or drag it down to put the keyboard away.
The model you're talking to is the title of the chat; tap it to change models.
Light haptics on send, stop, copy and model changes.
Placeholder Projects and Library entries are gone from the sidebar until they're real; Router stays in Settings.
